clusters.reason: All four are the same static settlement-ratio promise ('up to 50% / a fraction') with an eligibility-check CTA — only the wording changes, so Meta reads them as one Entity ID.
Both lean on official/federal-program framing implying forgiveness; same angle and format collapses them into a single concept.

gaps: Pre-crisis 'warning signs' targeting — every ad assumes the person is already in crisis; none catch people upstream before they panic, the market's biggest open lane
Stop-the-collection-calls relief — no ad addresses the acute daily pain of collector harassment, a proven high-urgency hook
Couple/shared-debt narrative — your set is all cold settlement math; no emotional identification angle despite its proven longevity
